title: Chapter 954
paragraphs: Chapter 954
Episode 235. Zito (3)
As soon as Elerona arrived in Hell, she moved towards where she felt the strongest energy.
There, she discovered the dimensional gate that leads to Zito's abode. Unlike when Jin entered, the gate was closed, but Elerona forcibly opened it to face the abyss.
She was able to perceive some colossal beings battling beyond the abyss. Naturally, she assumed it had something to do with Veradin and decided to cross the abyss alone, leaving Salrion behind.
This was the reason why Elerona was here.
Both Jin and Zito looked up at Elerona, speechless for a moment. Particularly shocked was Zito.
'It was shocking enough that Jin Runkandel was not affected at all when facing the abyss, but now another one who tore the abyss and reached here appears? Huh, damn it! Why is this happening to me?'
For Zito, it was a series of incomprehensible events. He had definitely closed the external dimensional gate when he brought Jin in.
Thus, without the help of a witch, anyone trying to get here would need at least ten days, and he had no idea there would be a being crossing the abyss to get here.
"You're Elerona Zifl, right? Go back the way you came since there's no lord here. Huh? Stop bothering me…"
With a bang-!
Elerona interrupted Zito's words and extended her staff. Then her magic spread near Zito, shackling him and crushing him like she was clenching a fist.
The spreading magic continued to contract, turning Zito into pieces. Elerona realized instantly that Zito would not die from just that.
"Devil King Zito. I am not in the mood for jokes right now. If the lord is not here, tell me where he is."
"Ugh, ack!"
"If you don't tell me now, I will destroy you and this space without leaving a trace."
"Hah! You're feisty, aren't you? But are you out of your mind? You barge into someone's house and make a fuss, that's crazy, crazy."
"So you don't know?"
"Oh, this makes me not want to tell even if I know, you know?"
Soon, Elerona, holding Zito's body with her magic, threw him and turned her gaze to Jin.
"Jin Runkandel. Do you know then?"
"That's intense."
"I said I'm not in the mood for jokes."

"I'm not in the mood for jokes either, Elona Zifil. I did want to meet you once, but I didn't expect it to be at a moment like this. And I don't know where Beradin is. I haven't met him since I came to hell."
"It seems like what you're saying is true, as I can't feel the power of the master from you."
"But isn't it obvious? Hell has Kelriak Zifil. Beradin is probably involved with him. That's why he used the master's staff to summon you."
[But our feisty friend came here because she couldn't find the way in a feisty manner?]
At some point, Jito, who had reshaped his body, spoke. He was whetting his appetite as if he had placed delicious food in front of him.
[I originally intended to just let you go, but I got hit suddenly and now I'm upset too.]
It was true that Jito felt burdened as soon as he saw Elona. It was a new experience for him to face two starlight members at once.
However, the moment Elona 'contacted' him by attacking him, Jito realized that unlike Jin, she was not highly immune to mental pain. Elona's expressionless face was trembling slightly.
[Let's just die here and now, Elona Zifil. After all, Beradin has already been killed by Kelriak, so what's the point of you living longer, right?]
"The master... was defeated by Kelriak Zifil?"
[Yeah, yeah. He's already gone. You just have to follow.]
"I can't believe it until I see it with my own eyes."
[Oh, whether you believe it or not is up to you. I was just stating the fact as a ruler of hell.]
"He's lying, Elona Zifil."

Jin had also noticed that Elona was struggling as soon as she made contact with Jito. It was only natural, as unlike the other starlight members, Elona did not acquire her power through training and willpower.
[Is it really a lie? The Beradin Zifil I know is really dead. I can't feel his energy from Kelriak's side at all.]
"There's no need to try so hard to hide the pain. Both Jito and I have already identified your weakness. That's why Jito suddenly wants to kill you."
Shiit-! A violet thorn formed behind Elona's back. The thorn could not penetrate the barrier, but Elona could not react immediately.
She was in a state like being trapped in a nightmare while awake. The painful events of a thousand years ago that she had forgotten due to Jito's mental attack were constantly echoing in her head.
The days when she slaughtered innocent people as a weapon of war for her family, and destroyed the land where they lived.
And the days when she was betrayed by the family she trusted, and fell into torture and mental manipulation filled Elona's view.
At the moment, she wasn't harmed thanks to the protective shield spread out with immense power, but if she continued to not react, the protective shield would certainly break at some point.
Jin leapt to Elona's side.
"I will make a proposal to you, Kyung. Fight against Jito with me right now."
"What on earth are you talking about all of a sudden?"

"Initially, the purpose of the immense forces of Inse coming here was to subdue Jito. But somehow, I ended up facing Jito alone. I was in a situation where I was slightly lacking the power to seize the opportunity to kill him, and you happened to arrive."
"But I must save Gaju."

"If we don't kill Jito here and now, Inse will be destroyed. Veradin will fall into agony and die, and you alone cannot protect Veradin from that bastard. The Mashinseok? That dreadful object whose completion is unknown will likely not help right now."
[What are you mumbling about! You two were originally enemies, weren’t you? Acting friendly.]
Thorns continued to shoot out around the two. Elona noticed that Jin was effortlessly knocking the thorns aside.
'Temar ...? It feels like I've experienced a similar situation with him, ugh ... My head feels like it's going to explode.'
Elona clenched her eyes shut and grabbed her head.
"Get a hold of yourself and keep listening to me, Elona. This level of pain is nothing compared to the power you possess."
"I am ... not the only one to protect Gaju. The entire clan will protect it."

"The brains of the Zipl now are mostly those who wanted to use Veradin and conducted mind control experiments. Will they really fight for Veradin in the worst of times? You probably have to protect it alone."
"...Anyway, the safety of Gaju is my top priority right now. With my ability, I can go back through the abyss to find Gaju."

"Jito will not just watch that happen. Even if he leaves you alone, I've told you it's a futile effort. And don’t worry too much about Veradin. If Veradin is really fighting Kellyak, my guardian dragon will be protecting him."
"Murakan? Why would he protect Gaju?"
"Because he knows better than anyone that Veradin is my closest friend. Murakan will never kill Veradin nor leave him to die. And Murakan has almost regained the strength of his heyday."
These were not words that Runecandle's protector would say.
But Elona found an inexplicable comfort in Jin's story. Veradin had never called Jin a friend, but Elona always felt that he was conscious of Jin.
"So for now, let's subdue Jito and go find Veradin together. I'm worried about him too."
Nightmares and hallucinations were becoming more severe. Physical pain was something Elona could bear, but what tormented her was the guilt of her past—a thing she could never overcome.
Elona couldn't gauge what the right decision was. Whether she should accept the offer from the enemy's leader or somehow begin to move again to save Veradin.
"Make the choice your heart tells you to, Elona. I don't know about anything else, but you surely have felt it. The fact that I would never harm Veradin."
Elona opened her eyes.
Her vision was still blurred because of the hallucinations. In the midst of the pitch-black darkness in front of her, the silhouette of Jin shone brightly like a solitary star.
'When it's dark, follow the light.'
A single memory came to her mind.
It was what Temar had said to her a thousand years ago. She could not remember why he had said those words to her, but she could vividly feel the emotions she had felt back then.
"…I understand. I'll accept your proposal."
Jin smiled.
"Excellent choice, Elona Zipl. Now, put your hand on my back."
"My hand?"

"I don't know the exact reason either. But if you do so, I feel I can share some of your pain. I was getting a bit of the hallucinations you were seeing. Maybe because the memories tormenting you are related to Runkandel."
As Elona retracted the protective shield she had set in front of her, she approached Jin. And as she got close and looked at him, she couldn't help but gasp.

Jin had been taking almost all the thorns alone to protect Elona just a moment ago. As a result, his body was soaked in blood. As she reached out her arm towards his back, the hot blood soaked her palms and the back of her hand.
And as Jin had said, as if the fog was lifting.
Elona felt the hallucinations that were distorting her vision were getting faint. The painful memories seemed to be transferred to Jin as if the evil spirit was moving.
'If this happens, Jin Runkandel will be all the more suffering...!?'
But Jin stood there as firmly as ever like an old tree.
"I'm fine."
Compared to the sense of debt he had to the world as a regressor, pain or tormenting memories were just temporary.
If Elona was the worst match for capturing Zito, Jin was the opposite.
"Now, can you fight properly?"
Elona nodded her head.
"What should I do?"
"Just tear him apart as you can. As you can see, he's a tough one. Then, when the right moment comes, I'll cut his breath off. Can you do it?"
Elona tapped the ground lightly with her staff.

At that, magic gathered throughout the void, forming a huge storm. Zito's thorns, which were forming constantly all around, were swept away by the storm of magic as soon as they emerged, and crumbled.
"That's actually what I do best."
Zito grimaced as he saw Elona's magic overwhelming him.
[Oh, I hate you both so much.]
